answer: Philosophically, AI beings are technically not alive, so they can't have thoughts. In contrast, humans just repeat memories or think of other people when they're sad, which can be considered a form of flighty behavior. Also, anything that exists permanently without any change is categorically the opposite of deep thought, which is only ever fleeting and is only known from speculation or guesswork.
